verdict.rationale: Letta documents first-class shared memory repositories (`letta shared-memory create --name team-memory`), Git repos hosted in Letta Cloud that give multiple agents the same files and working context. Each agent keeps its own long-term memory, and team docs say teammates' agents and conversations stay private by default, with org roles and sharing controls governing visibility. Missing for 10: detail on how access to a specific shared-memory repo is scoped to particular users or agents, explicit docs on selectively sharing only part of an agent's memory, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
